issues.description: The field 'firstName' in Person.java has different visibility between the template and the solution. In the template it is declared private (encapsulated with getters/setters), while in the solution it is declared public. This inconsistency is structural (field visibility) and may confuse students about the intended encapsulation and class design.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of 'firstName' consistent across template and solution. Prefer keeping it private with public getter/setter (as in the template) to maintain encapsulation. Update solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java to declare 'firstName' as private and keep the existing getFirstName()/setFirstName() methods.
